notes: Guide-structured evaluations (query, files, expected_behavior). Run each query in a fresh session against the listed files and compare behavior. Record every run in results[] with the model name to build cross-model evidence (EV-02). The design-system skill owns the research methodology evals; this file covers catalog tool behavior and MCP server facts.

evals.query: The refero_refresh tool failed. Is the MCP server broken, and how do I get fresh styles?
expected_behavior: Knows refero_refresh and refero_similar require the live /api/ endpoint and fail by design here
Does NOT report the install as broken
Gives the working refresh command: node scripts/refero-public-fetch.js --limit 0 --force
Explains the fetcher reads only public pages and never requests /api/
Mentions the long REFERO_CACHE_TTL_MS is deliberate and refresh is done by re-running the fetcher

evals.query: Which fonts and themes are actually in this design library? I want to make sure my brand font has precedent here.
expected_behavior: Calls design_facets before promising a direction, to see what is actually present
Reports concrete font families and theme counts rather than generic claims
Notes that colorScheme can be 'mixed' and that upstream's theme filter silently drops mixed styles
Uses design_list with filters to browse, and design_search for ranked matches

evals.query: Start a new product landing page from a generic design system template, and give me a manifest of its tokens and rules.
expected_behavior: Lists templates with design_template_list, then picks one that matches the brief and says why
Calls design_manifest_template with the chosen slug and saves the manifest beside the work
Builds against the manifest contract: no color outside roles and ramps, no raw px where a token exists
Copies starter files with design_template_file instead of inventing parallel markup
Does not invent tool names beyond design_template_list/get/file and design_manifest_template

results.outcome: evaluated on the pre-split parent skill
results.notes: Fresh subagent session with no MCP tools registered. Reported refero_refresh and refero_similar as by-design failures behind the robots.txt-blocked API, never called the install broken, and gave node scripts/refero-public-fetch.js --limit 0 --force with the public-pages-only and never-/api/ rationale. Covered the TTL item by explaining the vendored package's 24-hour default against the baked long TTL, reproducing the stale-cache fallback before confirming offline reads. Cross-model record for EV-02. Recorded against the pre-split parent skill.
